collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - VILLAGE MOMENTS (VFX-01..12, draft for the owner, 2026-11-18)
Songs, chants and speeches, a long lazy afternoon, rain on the way, a roof patched with cloth: small moments where the whole village does something together, and the island answers.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

collection.description: A mild fever goes around: rest and boiled water, or carry on working.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A fever is going around the village: nothing serious, just aching heads and hot foreheads. (name1), who knows a little about healing, has to decide how to deal with it.

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: (name1) has everyone drink boiled water and rest in the shade for a day. By morning the fever is gone, from everyone.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: The village decides there is too much to do to stop. The fever spreads a little further before it burns itself out.
